fun_facts: After his family moved to western Michigan in seventh grade, Kirk Cousins became an all-conference athlete in basketball, football, and baseball at Holland Christian High School.
As a young kid in Chicago, Kirk Cousins watched Purdue quarterback Drew Brees play.

At Michigan State, Kirk Cousins finished his college career as the school’s record holder in passing touchdowns, passing yards, completions, passing efficiency, total offense, and 200-yard passing games.
Kirk Cousins was a three-time team captain at Michigan State.
Kirk Cousins graduated with a degree in kinesiology, had a 3.684 GPA, and was a four-time Academic All-Big Ten selection.

excerpts:
And when Cousins approached the mound as a high-schooler at Holland (Mich.) Christian High School – his family relocated to Western Michigan in seventh grade – it's like nothing changed.

Whether he was the third or second baseman, shortstop or pitcher, he didn't throw "gas." But, it lit a fire under Cousins, who was an all-conference athlete in three sports at the school (basketball, football and baseball).

"I didn't throw it hard," Cousins said. "I threw it hard enough to be a decent high school player. But I wasn't going to play anywhere big in college."

So he thought.

He finished his collegiate career as the all-time record holder in passing touchdowns (66), passing yards (9,131), completions (723), passing efficiency (146.1 rating), total offense (9,004 yards) and 200-yard passing games (26).
citations.title: Five Words: Father’s Lesson Inspires Kirk Cousins

excerpts:
Not many teams threw a lot in the Big Ten, let alone from a spread look, but one quarterback did: Purdue's [Drew Brees](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/2580/drew-brees) . So Cousins, as a young kid in Chicago, watched him. Even now, Cousins can rattle off plays from a Purdue win that season over Ohio State, specifically Brees' touchdown pass on a post route.

"They were fun to watch," Cousins said. "I've followed him ever since."

Eventually, watching turned into learning, and that's made Brees into one of the bigger influences on Cousins' career -- sometimes in subtle ways.
citations.title: From allergies to pump fakes, Kirk Cousins has learned from Drew Brees - ESPN - NFL Nation- ESPN
